```{julia}
using DrWatson
@quickactivate

using Statistics
using Plots

include(srcdir("simulation2.jl"))

result = sim_repair(
    N=10,
    S=3,
    repairers=2,
    seed=42
)

println("Crash time: ", result.crash_time)
println("Average queue length: ", result.avg_queue)
println("Repair utilization: ", result.utilization)


gr()

p = plot(
    result.times,
    result.machines,
    xlabel = "Time",
    ylabel = "Working machines",
    label = "Machines",
    lw = 2,
    title = "Working machines over time"
)

savefig(p, plotsdir("machines_over_time.png"))

println("Plot saved.")

λ = 1/100
μ = 1.0
N = 10
R = 2

ρ = (N * λ) / (R * μ)

println("Analytical utilization estimate: ", ρ)
```
